data.narrative:
Alpine Eagle is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Jan-Hendrik Boelens and Timo Breuer, having raised €10.25M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparables across the defense tech sector—2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The analysis applied peer-median valuation across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). This peer set yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given data availability.

The triangulated valuation range is $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. This implies a post-money valuation approximately 39x the capital deployed to date. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 3-peer sample—particularly the wide dispersion between floor ($125M) and ceiling ($1.0B)—and the limited applicability of public comparables given the early-stage, capital-intensive nature of frontier defense technology. The valuation is highly sensitive to stage-specific risk factors and the pace of technical validation relative to peer cohorts.
